metadata.description: Plugins for coding agents by hoaj: CLI skills for websites, made with site-cli-creator, the generator itself, and slides-skill-creator.

plugins.name: logbuy
plugins.description: Find deals on Visma LogBuy (mylogbuy.com): search products, show a deal, browse categories.

plugins.name: site-cli-creator
plugins.description: Turn the calls a website makes into a plugin of CLI skills that coding agents can run, with Drift checks and a feedback loop.

plugins.name: slides-skill-creator
plugins.description: Create and maintain skills that build on-brand HTML slide decks from a brand's guidelines, logo, fonts and PowerPoint template, on a shared, upgradable Engine.

plugins.name: yousee
plugins.description: Read your Mit YouSee subscription, bills and usage.

plugins.name: totalkredit
plugins.description: Read Totalkredit's current bond prices and rates (kurser og renter) for paying out and redeeming mortgage loans.
